name: DCB Bank Ltd
title: DCB Bank Ltd - 532772 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: DCB Bank Q4 FY26: record PAT INR 206 cr, NIM 3.39% (+12bp QoQ), GNPA 2.45%, slippage 2.28% vs 3.09%, but management guides 18–20% growth and CASA growth flat in CA.

triggers.label: NIM 3.39%, up 12bp QoQ
triggers.quote: On net interest margin, the uptick continues, 3.39%, which we recorded in Q4 is 12 basis points higher than the sequential quarter
triggers.highlight: 3.39%, which we recorded in Q4 is 12 basis points higher

triggers.label: Slippage 3.09% → 2.28%
triggers.quote: the slippage ratio is 2.28%, down from 3.09%

triggers.label: Mortgage growth 3.8% QoQ in Q4
triggers.quote: the 3.5% of the mortgage book that we are growing in the quarter is a supremely better quality
triggers.highlight: 3.5% of the mortgage book that we are growing in the quarter

triggers.label: CA growth flat; SA growth 10%
triggers.quote: our SA growth is 10%. Our CA growth is flat, and that's not a good thing to happen.

guidance.value: 45 to 55 bps; below 45 bps near term
guidance.quote: as of now, we're sticking to the below 45 bps, okay?
we are reasonably confident of our 2.5% cost to average assets going forward
I don't see our net NPA going back above 1%.

guidance.value: till late Q2, perhaps early Q3
guidance.quote: we expect the deposit repricing benefit to come till late Q2, perhaps early Q3.
I expect us to hit 13,000 kind of number by the end of this particular year.
there is a very high probability that we'll cross the 500 branch barrier

guidance.value: about INR 1,100-1,200 crore; INR 1,500 crore enabling resolution
guidance.horizon: late Q2 or early Q3 FY27
guidance.quote: we should be going in for a fundraise because we see that as a bank
in the current year '26- '27, I'm not telling you the percentage, but it will be exactly the same as the overall asset growth of the bank.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Co-lending book below 15% at year end
prior_guidance_check.quote: we said that the co-lending book at the end of the year would be less than 15%. It is at 13.9%.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Credit cost for the year at or below 45 bps
prior_guidance_check.quote: had assured that there's no way we're going to be higher than 45 basis points credit cost for the year, we had clocked in 40.
we expect the deposit repricing benefit to come till late Q2, perhaps early Q3.

red_flags.label: CA growth flat; bulk deposits ~20%
red_flags.quote: Our CA growth is flat, and that's not a good thing to happen.

red_flags.label: Gold loan slippage 5.3% vs ex-gold 1.4%
red_flags.quote: Gold have a weightage of 21% and a slippage of 5.3%.

red_flags.label: Mortgage growth slowed; MSME flat
red_flags.quote: It's not growing. It is stuck where it is.

evasions.quote: So at a bank level, is it done? Fully, no.
I'm not telling you the percentage
It can happen. I mean can it be range bound in this particular level? Possible.
